title: Work
content: Work is defined as the product of force and distance moved in the direction of the force.
e: Work is defined as the product of force and distance moved in the direction of the force. Work is force times the distance moved along that force. If the force is perpendicular to the motion, that force does no work.

title: Energy
content: Energy is defined as the capacity to do work.
e: Energy is defined as the capacity to do work. Energy is measured or named exactly that way in this chapter.

title: Kinetic Energy
content: Energy acquired by a body due to its motion is called kinetic energy.
e: Energy acquired by a body due to its motion is called kinetic energy. Kinetic Energy is the capacity to do work. Kinetic energy grows with the square of the speed.

title: Potential Energy
content: The energy stored in a body due to its position or configuration is called the potential energy.
e: The energy stored in a body due to its position or configuration is called the potential energy. Potential Energy is the capacity to do work. Raise a mass or stretch a spring and you store potential energy.

title: Gravitational Potential Energy
content: Gravitational potential energy is the energy which a body possesses because of its position relative to the ground.
e: Gravitational potential energy is the energy which a body possesses because of its position relative to the ground. Gravitational Potential Energy is the capacity to do work. Raise a mass or stretch a spring and you store potential energy.

title: Elastic Potential Energy
content: The potential energy due to configuration is called elastic potential energy.
e: The potential energy due to configuration is called elastic potential energy. Elastic Potential Energy is the capacity to do work. Raise a mass or stretch a spring and you store potential energy.
